limits: This is an AI editorial review of frozen headline-level evidence, not an independent audit of complete article bodies, private trading records or publisher archives.

Approximate indexed publication times do not certify original publication vintage. High-risk future outcomes are omitted; boundary-aged company-result references are omitted when their eligibility cannot be established confidently from the permitted evidence.
Retrospectively retrieved market cards may include vendor corrections; the review verifies the briefing against those frozen cards and does not certify an original unrevised price-history vintage.
The nonretail component hash binds this review. Later retail-only merges change the full-spec hash but do not invalidate unchanged nonretail content.
